Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines a historical time noun with another “time of” expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 医：医生，The original word refers to medicine or medical treatment; the noun for a person whose job is treating patients is the corrected word. [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，The sentence means that he sees someone, rather than merely looks; this meaning needs the resultative complement. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，Use the corrected word for people other than oneself or the person being discussed; the original form is not appropriate here. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一种很漂亮的植物，Plants use the measure word shown in the correction, not the general measure word used for people or many objects. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他有一个问题，他不知道：他有一个问题，不知道，After the subject has appeared earlier in the same sentence, use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农听说：他听说，The name was mentioned in the immediately preceding sentence and there is no competing character, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方：神农走了三个月，找到了有植物的地方，Put the duration after the action verb; both the journey and the successful finding are completed actions, so they take 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
医 does not mean a doctor, whereas 医生 correctly refers to the person.
这里要表达“看见”病人，看到 correctly supplies the resultative meaning.
别的人 is wrong here under the teacher's rule, but it should be 病人 rather than 别人.
一个植物 can correctly refer to one individual plant, so changing it to 一种 is not required.
Repeating 他 as the subject of the following clause is acceptable and is not a reference error.
神农 was mentioned very recently and no other character competes for reference, so the teacher's rule prefers 他.
The duration must follow the verb, and both the completed journey and successful finding are correctly marked with 了.
